import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getNewcomerInfoData } from '@src/response-apps/recharge/newcomerInfo/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const result = await getNewcomerInfoData(uid, bid);

    if (result.code === 'NOT_IN_PERIOD') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('您已过新人期，无法参与充值狂欢活动。');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'FAILED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('查询失败，请稍后再试。');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(`活动进度：第${result.currentDay}天/共${result.contentDays}天`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`今日充值：${result.todayRechargedYuan.toFixed(0)}元/${result.thresholdYuan}元`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('【每日奖励】');

    for (const day of result.dayRewards) {
      md.addNewline();

      const title = day.canClaim ? `第${day.day}天` : `第${day.day}天 ${day.statusTag}`;

      md.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown([title, day.rewardText], day.canClaim ? [{ label: '领取', command: `/新人返利领取 ${day.day}` }] : []));
    }

    md.addNewline();

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '新人返利', content: md, footer: [{ label: '充值', command: '/充值' }] }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('查询新人狂欢信息失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('查询失败，请稍后再试。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
